description: Two years after her disbarment, Lidia is campaigning for women's legal and political rights when the murder of journalist Attila Brusaferro exposes a deeper conspiracy. She and Jacopo follow the trail toward Nitti while new prosecutor Pierluigi Fourneau becomes both investigative partner and romantic complication, and Enrico is pushed toward a parliamentary career that could advance Lidia's proposed law. Separate murders keep intersecting with the political plot until the conspiracy and Lidia's personal loyalties collide.

s02e01.description: Lidia is arrested during a campaign for women's voting rights just as journalist Attila Brusaferro is murdered and found carrying two coded messages. Released by prosecutor Pierluigi Fourneau, she works with Jacopo to decode Attila's last leads, while the investigation begins exposing the political network that will dominate the season.

s02e02.description: A student named Laura is accused of poisoning Beatrice at an elite girls' boarding school, and Lidia examines the school's rivalries and hidden relationships rather than accepting the obvious suspect. Jacopo continues tracing Attila's murder in parallel, while Marianna's engagement draws the Poët family into the Duke's social circle.

s02e03.description: A sequence of murdered women brings Lidia and Fourneau together on the same investigation, with criminologist Cesare Lombroso supplying a competing theory of the killer. As Enrico weighs a parliamentary campaign, Lidia and Fourneau's professional partnership becomes personal, while Jacopo finds a connection between Attila's death, Juvarra and Nitti.

s02e04.description: Andrea Caracciolo returns from America to marry Letizia, but a man is killed during the wedding celebrations and Letizia becomes the principal suspect. Lidia discovers that the victim was tied to an usurer and had a child with Letizia; Andrea takes responsibility for the killing and escapes to Switzerland, while Enrico commits to entering Parliament.

s02e05.description: Prisoner Bruno Corsi escapes Le Nuove and is accused of murdering a guard, but Lidia and Fourneau find evidence that corruption inside the prison may have framed him. Jacopo finally locates Nitti, only for the man to be killed before the documents he possesses can safely expose the larger conspiracy.

s02e06.description: Enrico wins his parliamentary election as Fourneau takes control of the evidence recovered from Attila and Nitti. Lidia and Jacopo help expose Garrone and the men plotting against Prime Minister Depretis, while Marianna breaks from the marriage arranged around her and Jacopo leaves Turin for Rome after the conspiracy collapses.
